children: rose 2.81% premarket after Oppenheimer upgraded it to Outperform from Perform with a $90 price target, pointing to AI search benefits, product improvements and app engagement.
Oppenheimer values Etsy at 12x 2027 EBITDA, a 10% discount to eBay Inc.

despite what it describes as similar growth. It raised fiscal 2026 gross merchandise sales by 1% and now models 5% GMS growth in 2027 and 2028, even allowing for share loss within the online handmade market.

The work behind it leans on two data sets. A regression of SimilarWeb visits implies third-quarter non-app buyers flat year over year against negative 3% in the second quarter, which Oppenheimer reads as putting the high end of GMS guidance within reach. It forecasts second-half non-app GMS growth matching the second quarter while assuming no improvement in app GMS on a two-year basis, which it calls conservative given the product changes. A survey of 2,500 US consumers points to a competitive moat and reduced dependence on Google Search.

title: Oppenheimer Prices Etsy at a 10% Discount to eBay
